description: Implement the optional SPU Observation Unit supporting pattern for observation activity (call, callback, sampling, subscription) against Step-owned target scopes. Observation Records remain independent of StepExecutionResult and preserve provenance/custody. Association establishes applicability only without guaranteeing active observation. Implement Observation Unit Association and Lifecycle contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Observation activity against target scopes implemented
Observation Record provenance: stepInstanceIdentity, observationUnitIdentity, observationUnitAssociationIdentity, associationTargetIdentity, observationInvocationIdentity, observationRecordIdentity
Association = applicability only; does not guarantee active observation
Step Composition sole authority for association establishment/change/dissociation
Dissociation does not erase observation records; historical provenance retained
definitionOfDone: Architecture test: no automatic observation guarantee from association
testStrategy: Observation record tests; association lifecycle tests; provenance audit tests
